criteria.name: Text Type
criteria.feedback: Your essay is excellently organized, with a clear introduction, well-developed body paragraphs that use strong transitions, and a thoughtful conclusion—all of which make your ideas very easy to follow.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.feedback: Your essay thoroughly proposes and develops the improvement of public safety for young people, offering specific examples, clear reasoning, and a strong discussion of both immediate and long-term consequences, all in varied and effective language.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Your essay demonstrates strong command of grammar and a wide range of structures, with only minor spelling and phrasing mistakes (such as 'sorrounded', 'a feel of protection'), but your meaning is always clear. To further improve, focus on refining awkward wording and double-check spelling for even greater accuracy.
